entry.label: Viable System Model (VSM)
entry.description: The Viable System Model is a management-cybernetic model for examining the functions and communications through which an organisation maintains autonomy, coordination, intelligence, identity and adaptation across recursive levels.
entry.canonical_definition: A management-cybernetic model for diagnosing and designing the functions and communications by which an organisation maintains viable autonomy and cohesion in a changing environment across recursive levels.

profile.title: Viable System Model
profile.canonical_definition: A management-cybernetic model for diagnosing and designing the functions and communications by which an organisation maintains viable autonomy and cohesion in a changing environment across recursive levels.
profile.summary: The VSM is a model of the functions and communications needed for an organisation to remain viable in a changing environment. It distinguishes autonomous operations from meta-systemic functions for coordination, internal regulation, intelligence and policy, and applies recursively.
profile.why_it_matters: The model makes the autonomy-cohesion problem explicit. It asks whether local operations can absorb relevant variety, whether conflicts are damped, whether the whole gains synergy, whether intelligence reaches strategy and whether identity closes the system without suffocating it.
historical_lineage: Beer developed the model from management practice and cybernetics
Brain of the Firm and Heart of Enterprise developed the theory
Diagnosing the System for Organizations provided a diagnostic guide
Cybersyn and later organisational practice extended its application
dependent_subsequents: Team Syntegrity as a related Beer practice
practice_connections: start from primary operations and their environments
map actual regulatory work rather than formal boxes
look for missing or overloaded functions
test communication channels for timeliness and capacity
common_misreadings: five boxes to assign to departments
central control dressed as systems thinking
governance is from outside the system
open_checks: primary page locators for recursion and requisite variety
relations to power, ethics and democratic governance
profile.editorial_note: Readable orientation and evidence-backed first pass. Not accepted scholarly consensus until named review is recorded.
